source_text: Si peccaverit in sanctis Domini, addet quintam partem. Restitutio cum incremento. Gratia non fraudem nutrit. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: If will-have-sinned against holy-things of-Lord, he-will-add fifth part. Restitution with increase. Grace not fraud nourishes. Amen.
pass_b_english: If he sins regarding the Lord’s holy things, he [[adds a fifth >> Bible:Leviticus 5:16]]. Restitution with increase. Grace does not feed fraud. Homilia III CLOSEOUT. Amen.
